name: Snowball
description: Think-pair-share, digitally enforced: everyone answers alone, then pairs see each other's answers and merge them into one stronger answer the whole class sees. Nobody can skip the thinking step and every voice enters the funnel. Works for content review and for community questions like class norms. Good for focus, consensus, and making sure every voice counts.
tagline: Perfect for 'most important cause of WWI', 'what should our class norms be', or any one big question.

prompt.label: The one question
prompt.helper: The question everyone answers alone first.
prompt.placeholder: What should our class norms be?

mergeInstruction.label: Merge instruction
mergeInstruction.helper: Shown to pairs above the shared text box.

snowballAgain.label: Snowball again (groups of 4)
snowballAgain.helper: After pairs merge, two pairs join into a group of four and merge once more — one extra distillation round.

template.name: Snowball
template.description: Alone, together, all of us — one question, distilled by everyone.

intro.message:
Three rounds: alone, together, all of us.

First you'll answer on your own — nobody can skip the thinking step. Then you and a partner will merge your answers into one. Then the whole class sees what the pairs built.

end.message: Started as everyone's own idea. Ended as a few strong ones — built by all of us.
